BENEFITS OF INGREDIENTS 


 Dhanadanayana ( Caesalpinia bonducella ) – It is a potent herb to treat fever because the main property of this plant is antipyretic This plant is also very effective to treat elephantiasis and other inflammatory conditions. 

 Shunthi ( Zingiber officinale ) – It has piercing nature and acts as a restorative agent that provides strength to the body and enhances the immunity power. 

 Shigru ( Moringa oleifera ) – It is antioxidant and immunomodulatory in nature. It acts as a muscle relaxant hence useful in the treatment of facial paralysis. 

 Rasna ( Pluchea lanceolata ) – Rasna is analgesic and anti-inflammatory in nature. It reduces pain and stiffness hence useful in facial paralysis and fever where vitiated vata is responsible. 

 Ugragandha ( Acorus calamus ) – This herb strengthens the nervous system as it is one among the medhya herbs that help to improve memory power, speech and intelligence. 

 Varuna ( Crataeva nurvala ) – It is a diuretic in nature which corrects the downward of Apana vata hence useful in treating constipation and headache. 

 Lasuna ( Allium sativum ) – It is the best Rasayan and Vatahar dravaya that pacifies Vata dosha. By regular use of lasuna one can become disease free and it also prevents further progression of disease. Basically, it helps to enhance immunity power of a person. 

 Krishan ( Piper longum ) – It is carminative in nature and reduces aggravated vata level in the body. It is used as a tonic which strengthens our immunity, apart from that it is also useful in treating inflammation in body. 

 Chitraka ( Plumbago zeylanica ) – The roots of this herb are used as stimulant and they regulate the normal functions of the nervous system. 

 Eranda ( Ricinus communis ) – It is a mild laxative but apart from that it helps to treat insomnia by calming the brain. 

 Surtaru ( Cedrus deodara ) – It is highly beneficial in treating vata dosha disorders like paralysis, neuralgia, constipation and bloating. 

 Ghana ( Cyperus rotundus ) – The antioxidant potential of this herb makes it potential for treating nervous system disorders. 

 Pathya ( Terminalia chebula ) – Pathya is the best herb with anti-oxidant properties, it is used in the treatment of Vata vitiated disorders. 

 Barbara ( Clerodendron serratum ) – This plant is loaded with antiseptic, astringent and styptic properties. It is used to relieve headache. 




 METHOD OF PREPARATION 
 All above mentioned herbs are taken in coarse powder form. With this churana decoction is prepared with water till it is reduced to one eighth. After completion of this process, the decoction is transferred into glass jars and used in the treatment of Vata disorders.

DHANADANAYANADI KASHAYAM – INGREDIENTS, INDICATIONS, USES AND BENEFITS 
 
 INTRODUCTION 
 Dhanadanayanadi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine which is prepared from multiple herbs. It is an effective medicine for the treatment of facial paralysis and paralysis. It is also used in the treatment of fever which occurs due to aggravation of Vata dosha. 
 
 
 INGREDIENTS 
 
 
Dhanadanayana ( Caesalpinia Bonducella ) – 1 Part 
 
Shunthi ( Zingiber Officinale ) – 1 Part 
 
Shigru ( Moringa Oleifera ) – 1 Part 
 
Rasna ( Pluchea Lanceolata ) – 1 Part 
 
Ugragandha ( Acorus Calamus ) – 1 Part 
 
Varuna ( Crataeva Nurvala ) – 1 Part 
 
Lasuna ( Allium Sativum ) – 1 Part 
 
Krishan ( Piper Longum ) – 1 Part 
 
Chitraka ( Plumbago Zeylanica ) – 1 Part 
 
Eranda ( Ricinus Communis ) – 1 Part 
 
Surataru ( Cedrus Deodara ) – 1 Part 
 
Ghana ( Cyperus Rotundus ) – 1 Part 
 
Pathya ( Terminalia Chebula ) – 1 Part 
 
Barbara ( Clerodendron Serratum ) – 1 Part 
 
Water – 16 times 
 
 
 
 
 REFERENCE – SAHASARYOGAM KASHYA PRAKARANA 
 
 
 BENEFITS OF INGREDIENTS 
 
 
 Dhanadanayana ( Caesalpinia bonducella ) – It is a potent herb to treat fever because the main property of this plant is antipyretic This plant is also very effective to treat elephantiasis and other inflammatory conditions. 
 
 Shunthi ( Zingiber officinale ) – It has piercing nature and acts as a restorative agent that provides strength to the body and enhances the immunity power. 
 
 Shigru ( Moringa oleifera ) – It is antioxidant and immunomodulatory in nature. It acts as a muscle relaxant hence useful in the treatment of facial paralysis. 
 
 Rasna ( Pluchea lanceolata ) – Rasna is analgesic and anti-inflammatory in nature. It reduces pain and stiffness hence useful in facial paralysis and fever where vitiated vata is responsible. 
 
 Ugragandha ( Acorus calamus ) – This herb strengthens the nervous system as it is one among the medhya herbs that help to improve memory power, speech and intelligence. 
 
 Varuna ( Crataeva nurvala ) – It is a diuretic in nature which corrects the downward of Apana vata hence useful in treating constipation and headache. 
 
 Lasuna ( Allium sativum ) – It is the best Rasayan and Vatahar dravaya that pacifies Vata dosha. By regular use of lasuna one can become disease free and it also prevents further progression of disease. Basically, it helps to enhance immunity power of a person. 
 
 Krishan ( Piper longum ) – It is carminative in nature and reduces aggravated vata level in the body. It is used as a tonic which strengthens our immunity, apart from that it is also useful in treating inflammation in body. 
 
 Chitraka ( Plumbago zeylanica ) – The roots of this herb are used as stimulant and they regulate the normal functions of the nervous system. 
 
 Eranda ( Ricinus communis ) – It is a mild laxative but apart from that it helps to treat insomnia by calming the brain. 
 
 Surtaru ( Cedrus deodara ) – It is highly beneficial in treating vata dosha disorders like paralysis, neuralgia, constipation and bloating. 
 
 Ghana ( Cyperus rotundus ) – The antioxidant potential of this herb makes it potential for treating nervous system disorders. 
 
 Pathya ( Terminalia chebula ) – Pathya is the best herb with anti-oxidant properties, it is used in the treatment of Vata vitiated disorders. 
 
 Barbara ( Clerodendron serratum ) – This plant is loaded with antiseptic, astringent and styptic properties. It is used to relieve headache. 
 
 
 
 
 METHOD OF PREPARATION 
 All above mentioned herbs are taken in coarse powder form. With this churana decoction is prepared with water till it is reduced to one eighth. After completion of this process, the decoction is transferred into glass jars and used in the treatment of Vata disorders. 
 
 
 INDICATIONS 
 
 Dhanadanayanadi kashayam is indicated in treatment of facial paralysis, tremors, and fever.
 
 
 
 USES AND BENEFITS OF DHANADANAYANADI KASHAYAM 
 
 
This herbal formulation is used in Vata aggravated conditions. It is used in the treatment of facial paralysis, hemiplegia and paraplegia. 
 
It is used to manage tremors which occur in Parkinson’s disease. Tremors occurred due to an increased level of Vata dosha in the body which hampers the normal functions of the nervous system. 
 
 
 
 
 DOSAGE 
 5 to 15 ml once or twice daily with four times boiled and cooled water as advised by physician. 
 
 
     
 MANUFACTURER 
 Arya Vaidya Pharmacy 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
